Job Description AI/ML Engineer (Edge AI Deep Learning)



Organization - LG Soft India, Bangalore
Position: AI/ML Engineer Edge AI Computing
Experience: 2-5 Years (can be adjusted based on requirement)
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Department: AI Research Development


Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled AI/ML Engineer with strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Edge AI Computing. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and deploying AI models on resource-constrained edge devices. The role requires deep understanding of ML/DL fundamentals, model optimization techniques, mathematical foundations of neural networks, and hands-on experience with industry-standard AI frameworks and algorithms.


Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, train, and optimize Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for edge computing environments.
Implement and deploy AI solutions on low-resource computing platforms with focus on performance, accuracy, and power efficiency.
Develop and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines including data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, validation, and deployment.
Perform model tuning, optimization, quantization, pruning, and verification for production deployment.
Apply transfer learning techniques to improve model accuracy and reduce training efforts.
Evaluate and benchmark AI models for latency, memory consumption, and computational efficiency.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI algorithms into embedded and edge systems.
Analyze model performance and continuously improve accuracy, robustness, and scalability.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI, Deep Learning, and Edge Computing technologies.


Required Technical Skills

AI/ML Fundamentals

Strong understanding and hands-on experience in:
Machine Learning (ML)
Deep Learning (DL)
Model Optimization Verification
Transfer Learning
Statistical Modeling
Predictive Analytics


Machine Learning Deep Learning Frameworks

TensorFlow
PyTorch
Keras
Scikit-Learn


Model Development Experience

Hands-on experience with:
CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks)
LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory)
GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit)
Regression Models
Random Forest
XGBoost
LightGBM
ARIMA/SARIMA Time Series Models


Programming Skills

Strong Python Programming
Good C++ Programming Skills
Experience in algorithm design and optimization

We are looking for an AI-LM (Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning) Engineer with 2 to 4 years of experience specializing in Physics AI. In this role, you will design and deploy Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), neural operators, and surrogate models that simulate complex structural, thermal, or fluid dynamics in real-time, bridging traditional numerical solvers with deep learning models.



Key Technologies

Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs)

Neural Operators (FNO, DeepONet)

Partial Differential Equations (PDEs / ODEs)

PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow

Scientific Computing (SciPy, NumPy, DeepXDE)

Finite Element Analysis (FEA) / CFD basics

Model Optimization & Edge Deployment

Python & Numerical Simulation

What you will do

Embed physical conservation laws (such as mass, energy, and momentum) directly into deep learning architectures and loss formulations.
Accelerate structural, fluid, and thermal simulations by building high-fidelity neural surrogate models executing in milliseconds.
Deploy lightweight and optimized machine learning models onto edge hardware controllers and real-time environments.
Collaborate with mechanical, industrial, and software engineering teams to model system physics and validate model consistency.

Requirements

2-4 years of professional experience building and deploying machine learning models, with a strong portfolio in Physics AI or scientific computing.
Deep mathematical grounding in partial differential equations (PDEs), calculus, and scientific simulation principles.
Mastery of Python and core deep learning frameworks (primarily PyTorch or JAX).
Hands-on familiarity with PINN solvers and libraries (e.g. DeepXDE, NVIDIA Modulus) is highly valued.
M.S. or Ph.D. in Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.

We are looking for a highly skilled AI Engineer with 2 to 7 years of experience to develop and deploy cutting-edge AI models and solutions. The ideal candidate will have expertise in LLMs, RAG systems, and computer vision. This position is based in uCube.ai.

Roles and Responsibility
Develop and deploy advanced AI models and solutions using LLMs, RAG systems, and computer vision.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business problems and develop AI-based solutions.
Design and implement scalable data pipelines for large datasets.
Work on developing and deploying machine learning models using various algorithms and techniques.
Conduct research and stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and related fields.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving overall code quality.
Job Requirements
Strong foundation in computer science and mathematics.
Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Junior AI Engineer to help us build useful software and AI-powered applications that solve practical problems for clients and users.

Strong programming fundamentals, curiosity, problem-solving ability, and a willingness to learn quickly are essential for this role.

You will work closely with our design and engineering teams to build application features, integrations, automation tools, and AI-assisted workflows.

You will get hands-on experience taking ideas from early prototypes to working software used by real people.

The role is designed for someone early in their engineering career who wants to learn by building, experimenting, receiving feedback, and taking increasing ownership over time.




What You'll Do

Develop application features, integrations, and automation workflows.
Build prototypes to test ideas and technical approaches.
Work with APIs, databases, and AI models to build useful product experiences.
Use AI-assisted development tools to help write, understand, debug, and test code.
Test your work, identify problems, and improve solutions based on feedback.
Learn how applications are deployed, monitored, and maintained in production.
Investigate technical problems using documentation, experimentation, and available tools.
Collaborate with designers, developers, and project stakeholders to understand requirements and build practical solutions.
Write clear, understandable code and be able to explain how your solution works.
Take responsibility for assigned work and communicate progress, questions, and blockers clearly.



To Qualify for the Role, You Should Have

Good logical reasoning and programming fundamentals.
Ability to write, understand, and debug code in at least one programming language.
Experience building software through personal projects, college projects, internships, freelance work, open-source contributions, or professional work.
Some experience using AI tools for coding, learning, debugging, research, or building applications.
Basic familiarity with concepts such as APIs, databases, Git/version control, and software testing.
Comfort learning from documentation and experimenting when you do not immediately know the answer.
Ability to understand and explain the code you write, including code developed with AI assistance.
Good communication skills, attention to detail, and care for the end-user experience.



What We Look For

We look for people who demonstrate:

Curiosity: You enjoy understanding how things work.
Initiative: When you encounter something unfamiliar, you try to figure it out.
Perseverance: You are willing to stay with difficult problems instead of giving up quickly.
Sincerity: You are dependable, communicate openly, and care about doing good work.
Learning ability: You are comfortable learning, unlearning, and relearning as technology changes.
Ownership: You take responsibility for your work and want to see it actually used.
Effort: You are willing to put in the work required to improve your craft.



Technologies and Tools

The technologies we use vary depending on the project.

Familiarity with any of them is useful, and you will have opportunities to learn others on the job.

Application Development: JavaScript, Python, React, React Native, Flutter, Django, Node.js.
Databases and Data Tools: PostgreSQL, MySQL, pgvector.
AI and Agents: Vercel AI SDK, Pydantic AI, LLM provider SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic), agentic browsers.
AI-Assisted Development: Cursor, Claude Code, Codex.



What We Offer

The opportunity to build software that is used by real clients and users.
Hands-on experience across application development, data, automation, and AI.
Close feedback and mentorship from experienced team members.
Increasing ownership as your skills develop.
A growth path into deeper areas of AI engineering, including model customization, evaluation, agent infrastructure, and AI application architecture.
Exposure to international product and technology projects.
A team that uses AI tools every day while continuing to care deeply about engineering fundamentals and software quality.



Who Will Thrive Here

The tools we use today will not be the tools we use forever. AI and software development are evolving quickly, and we expect our engineers to evolve with them.

We are therefore not looking for someone who already knows everything.

We are looking for someone who is curious, sincere, persistent, willing to work hard, and excited to keep learning.

Bring us strong fundamentals, the willingness to figure things out, and evidence that you enjoy building things.

Well help you with the rest.
